learning-signal.description: Emitted when a learner engages with content — views, reads, or interacts. The foundational attention signal for the learning economy.

mastery-achieved.description: Emitted when a learner levels up in mastery for a concept. Produces a mastery attestation that flows value to content stewards.

assessment-completed.description: Emitted when a learner completes an assessment or quiz. Triggers evaluation resource accounting and recognition flows.

path-completed.description: Emitted when a learner completes all steps in a learning path. A major milestone that produces path-completion attestation.

practice-engagement.description: Emitted when a learner actively practices with exercises, simulations, or interactive content. Distinct from passive viewing.

contribution-created.description: Emitted when a steward creates, curates, or reviews content. Produces a contribution record that builds stewardship standing.

experience-attestation.description: A :story-point attestation minted by the discernment gate when meaningful evidence is recognized. Emitted alongside the Holochain Link; dual-encoded as an EconomicEvent in shefa.

peer-review-completed.description: Emitted when a peer review of content is completed. Produces a peer attestation that strengthens content trust and steward standing.
